### Goal
Fix Stripe webhook signature verification causing customer 400 responses in `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`. Pagination remains paused.

### Constraints and rules
Run onboarding steps individually and in order. Never create or modify a Stripe webhook before posting the ADR link in `#billing-integrations` and tagging `@priya`. Keep commits small. Rebase onto `origin/main`; squash at 12 commits or when ready. Use `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `sbx-pay-a` is obsolete.

### Key decisions and facts
Billing typing is complete. CSV UTF-8 fix is complete. Full suite passes: 318 passed, 4 skipped in 14.92s. Test factories/fixtures reduced runtime. Onboarding step 4 succeeded; steps 5–8 remain.

### Ruled out
Do not increase SQLAlchemy pool size to 50. Do not resume pagination work.

### Progress
Reproduced invoice-sync race: 1/20 concurrent identical submissions returns 409 instead of 202. `InvoiceSyncService.submit` opens a session and forwards the idempotency key but does not persist completed responses. No Stripe webhook changes made.

### Next steps
Determine whether invoice-sync race is in scope, then inspect/reproduce Stripe signature failure, configuration, and tests. Post ADR link and tag `@priya` before webhook changes. Complete onboarding steps 5–8 sequentially.
